content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MCD Junior Resident (MBBS) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: MCD Junior Resident (MBBS) Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) for filling Junior Resident positions at Swami Dayanand Hospital located in Dilshad Garden, Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 regular vacancies available for the Junior Resident (MBBS) post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to directly attend the interview at the specified venue along with required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the MCD Junior Resident recruitment is scheduled to be held on 27 October 2026 with reporting at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree from a recognized University or Institution along with a complete one-year rotatory internship and Delhi Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for UR and EWS candidates?
faq.answer: For Unreserved and EWS candidates, the maximum age limit should not exceed 40 years as on the specified date of 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for Unreserved, EWS, and OBC candidates, payable via Bank Draft or Pay order in favor of the Commissioner, Municipal Corporation of Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary as per Pay Matrix Level - 10 along with usual allowances as admissible under the Residency Scheme.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at the Office of the Medical Superintendent, Swami Dayanand Hospital, Dilshad Garden, Delhi - 110095.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment for the Junior Resident (MBBS) post will be made on a regular basis for a duration of 6 months under the Residency Scheme.
